description: RiskyBird option-2 KU040 SoC (RocketKU040LeanConfig): ONE Rocket hart (rv64imafc, FP32 FPU, no D, no vector, no RoCC), 50 MHz, optionally engine D on the periphery bus. Every dispatch runs on hart 0 with the scalar backend (images are soft-float, -march=rv64imac -mabi=lp64); with engine D the network is one d_engine_s8 dispatch.

cores.name: rocket0
cores.description: Rocket, scalar backend for every op; drives engine D when present.
